Making gestures usable.

Turn your camera into an input device.

Gesleap turns a standard webcam into a clean control surface for general software, embedded systems, and industrial workstations.

Gesleap works where gesture control typically fails.

Most gesture products make you buy a sensor or a headset. Gesleap uses the camera you already have and works reliably and accurately.

Explore applications View products
No hardware needed

It runs on a plain webcam without any additional sensors.

Ease of setup

Runs out-of-the-box without requiring a setup and with preset settings.

Private and CPU-only

No account or log in and no user data collected. It runs fast and on the CPU.

Fully customizable

You can customize the actions, sensitivity and speed among others, to your own preferences. We also ship an external SDK for creating your own gesture apps.
